# Nancye D'Arienzo | Tucker Realty — Extended Summary

Source: https://www.nancyedarienzorealty.com/

## Who
Nancye D'Arienzo is a real estate agent at Tucker Realty, Powered by ERA, in Mount Vernon, Washington. She has lived in Skagit County for 20 years and built her career helping local families buy and sell homes.

## What she offers
- Buyer representation: local search guidance, neighborhood knowledge, negotiation and support through closing.
- Seller representation: pricing strategy, listing marketing, photo gallery presentation and a clear selling process (see https://www.nancyedarienzorealty.com/index-2.html).
- A full-service approach from start to close (see https://www.nancyedarienzorealty.com/about-property.html).

## Where
Mount Vernon and greater Skagit County, WA. Office: 1932 E College Way Ste A, Mount Vernon, WA 98273.

## How to reach
- Phone: (360) 941-5415
- Email: Nancyedarienzo25@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon - Sat, 9:00 am - 7:00 pm
- Contact page: https://www.nancyedarienzorealty.com/contact.html
